newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Tuan Sing to regionalise across Asia.
newsitem.headline: Tuan Sing to regionalise across Asia.

text.p: Diversified property and construction group Tuan Sing Holdings Ltd intends to step up its expansion across Asia, company chief executive officer and managing director Hwang Soo Chin said on Monday.
Speaking at a news briefing after the release of the group's 1996 results, Hwang said:
"We need to regionalise our business. We have made inroads into China, which is an emerging market and we are now looking at mature markets with good fundamentals."
He said Tuan Sing's agreement to buy a 38.8 percent stake in Australia's Grand Hotel Group Ltd for A$80.68 million in January 1997 was a step in this direction.

He said the Australian tourism industry was poised for tremendous growth and that Tuan Sing planned to be a long-term player in the industry. The Australian acquisition depends on Tuan Sing getting shareholders' approval.
He said the group was also looking at other hotel opportunities in the region, without giving details.
Hwang said the company's property projects in China had realised a small profit of about Singapore $300,000 in 1996. He said this was expected to increase in the current year.
"In Shanghai we have established ourselves as the leading foreign funded developer of local housing," he said.
He said the first phase of the group's Lu Yin Yuan project in Shanghai launched in July 1996 had been 75 percent sold.
In Singapore, the group had managed to sell 42 of 106 units in a Singapore housing project launched last week, he said.
